column5: vuln.go.dev/GO-2026-6909 (reported by aibeshkov, reviewed, published 2026-11-05, no fixed version, no CVE/GHSA alias): (1) ServiceProvider.validateAssertion dereferences assertion.Issuer without a nil check, so a signed response omitting <saml:Issuer> panics; internal/saml/provider.go parseResponseRecovered (l.284-294) wraps the library call in recover() and turns the panic into errInvalidSAMLResponse before it reaches the caller. (2) Subject uses the bare struct tag xml:"NameID", matching a <NameID> in any namespace, so a foreign-namespace NameID could spoof Subject.NameID.Value; strictAssertionShape (l.316+) re-parses the response with namespace resolution, requires exactly one NameID in the SAML assertion namespace and refuses a foreign-namespace NameID/Subject/Assertion sibling, and ParseResponse (l.275-278) refuses the response outright if the library's own Subject.NameID differs from the namespace-strict one. govulncheck flags ServiceProvider.ParseResponse at the symbol level because it cannot see either guard. Re-review at expiry: has crewjam/saml shipped a fix, is the finding still reachable the same way.
